analysis.title: Calumet Inc. (CLMT): First Take: Strong EBITDA Beat Driven by SPS; Focus on MRL Production Ramp
key_insights: Calumet reported 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA of $347.2 mn including tax attributes versus the GS estimate of ~$275 mn including tax attributes and FactSet consensus of ~$269 mn. Adjusted EBITDA excluding tax attributes was $322.0 mn.
Specialty Products & Solutions was the largest driver of the beat, with adjusted EBITDA of $248.1 mn versus the GS estimate of $205.2 mn and higher volumes (62.2 kbpd vs 61.1 kbpd).

Montana/Renewables (MRL) adjusted EBITDA including tax attributes was $110.6 mn versus the GS estimate of $82.9 mn. Excluding tax attributes it was $85.4 mn. Volumes were 24.1 kbpd versus 21.3 kbpd estimated.
Performance Brands adjusted EBITDA was $9.1 mn versus the GS estimate of $6.0 mn, with volumes roughly in line (1.9 kbpd vs 2.1 kbpd).

Corporate costs were $20.6 mn versus the GS estimate of $18.8 mn. Interest expense was roughly in line at $50.8 mn versus $50.0 mn, while SG&A was well above the GS forecast at $83.4 mn versus $45.9 mn.
Management said Calumet has retired ~$265 mn of debt since July, and that Montana/Renewables delivered record earnings since the SET2 RVO.

GS is focused on four items for the earnings call: macro commentary on renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, updates on leverage targets, the margin outlook for the base business, and the next leg of growth for MaxSAF operations.
GS rates CLMT Neutral with a 6-month SOTP-based price target of $57, which implies 31.5% upside from the $43.35 price as of the 5 Nov 2026 close.

market_movers.rationale: GS reiterates Neutral with a $57 6-month SOTP-based target, which implies 31.5% upside from $43.35. The report is a first take after a 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA beat driven by Specialty Products & Solutions and Montana/Renewables.

earnings_insights: CLMT 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA reported $347.2 mn including tax attributes versus GS estimate ~$275 mn (including tax attributes) and FactSet consensus estimate ~$269 mn. Reported adjusted EBITDA excluding tax attributes was $322.0 mn.

Segment adjusted EBITDA reported versus GS estimate: Specialty Products & Solutions $248.1 mn vs $205.2 mn, Performance Brands $9.1 mn vs $6.0 mn, Montana/Renewables $110.6 mn including tax attributes ($85.4 mn excluding) vs $82.9 mn, Corporate ($20.6 mn) vs ($18.8 mn).

Reported total facility production was 88.3 kbpd versus the GS estimate of 84.5 kbpd. Specialty Products & Solutions was 62.2 kbpd vs 61.1 kbpd, Montana/Renewables 24.1 kbpd vs 21.3 kbpd, and Performance Brands 1.9 kbpd vs 2.1 kbpd.
Reported SG&A was $83.4 mn versus the GS estimate of $45.9 mn, and reported interest expense was $50.8 mn versus $50.0 mn.
Company retired ~$265 mn of debt since July. Montana/Renewables delivered record earnings since SET2 RVO.

GS forecasts (estimates): FY2026E EBITDA $731.1 mn and EPS ($1.47). FY2027E EBITDA $840.5 mn and EPS $4.05. FY2028E EBITDA $808.3 mn and EPS $3.42. GS quarterly EPS estimates: 9/26E $1.88, 12/26E $1.37, 3/27E $0.95.
risk_factors: Key risks relate to earnings across the renewable diesel, specialty products and solutions, and Performance Brands segments.
SG&A came in well above GS forecasts, and the report flags leverage targets and the base business margin outlook as open items for the call.
